name: start_timer
description: Start a visible on-screen countdown for a timed step — shaking, stirring, steeping, chilling, or letting something rest. Call it when a step has a duration so the guest can keep their hands free. Does not return anything.

seconds.description: Duration in seconds, e.g. 15 for a hard shake or 120 for a two-minute chill.

label.description: Short label for what's being timed, e.g. "Shake" or "Chill the glass".
